observation: In the validateCommand of Cli.php, the OutcomeRepository validate method was called but it was not passed the $proposalsById array. This caused outcome records referencing active proposals to fail validation because the repository could not verify whether the referenced proposal actually existed.

evidence.summary: The test failed with a ValidationException because the CLI outcome loader couldn't match referenced proposals. Modifying Cli::validateCommand to pass $proposalsById to OutcomeRepository resolved the issue.

hypothesis: CLI commands that run repository-wide validation must chain and pass parsed references across repositories to maintain referential integrity checks (e.g. validating outcomes against proposals, and proposals against findings).
validated_conclusion: When executing repository-wide validations in CLI commands, ensure all parsed models are propagated to downstream loaders. In particular, validate outcomes using the list of parsed proposals to verify that every outcome references a valid proposal.
